profile.presentation: My name is Rafael MURO, a fullstack developer passionate about the world of web development. Ever since I was young, I've always been drawn to computers, writing my first lines of code by creating Minecraft mods. Today, as a web development student, I'm committed to designing custom tools that meet my clients' needs. Curious and always eager to learn, I fully invest myself in every project with perseverance and rigor. My goal? To build functional, intuitive and high-performance solutions that combine technology and user experience.
